Mixed protocol versions, Python-only macros, unverified registry/package combinations, publisher-only performance measurements and absence of executed SDK or accessibility tests prevent a higher dependability rating.

Access to permissive code does not establish open model weights, data or training methods; the cited experiments depend on hosted Gemini/Jev services, and end-to-end performance reproducibility was not demonstrated.
